notes: Identity independently inspected: title The Bias Blind Spot: Perceptions of Bias in Self Versus Others, authors Emily Pronin, Daniel Y. Lin and Lee Ross, PSPB Vol. 28 No. 3 March 2002 pp. 369–381 match the original reference. Supplied document is primary article text with methods/results and references across pp. 369–381, not an abstract or secondary article. DOI is not printed, so DOI identity is not independently corroborated. No PDF supplied; figure graphics are absent in text. Candidate N: 76 airport travelers completed the survey, with two questionnaire versions, one administered to 39 and the other to the remainder. Item-specific final analytic counts/exclusions not given. Candidate limitation tests are all ts < 1 for procrastination, public speaking and planning fallacy. Do not convert collective bound to an exact statistic or p, and do not assign one individual test. t(74) = 3.67, p < .0005 belongs to the different eight-bias composite. No N inferred from df.
